class.brief_description: Used for conditions and actions. You should define your own [code]on_tick()[/code] method where you do your logic.
class.description: The leaf node is used for conditions and actions. You should define your own [method on_tick] method where you do your logic. A leaf that does not override [method on_tick] returns [code]Status.FAILURE[/code] and reports an error once per node instance. Example: [gdscript] func on_tick(blackboard: Variant, delta: float) -> Status: return Status.SUCCESS [/gdscript]
